question: Who is the tallest superhero?
evidence: who refers to superhero_name; tallest superhero refers to MAX(height_cm);
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0 FROM (SELECT superhero_name AS c0, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS __r FROM superhero) AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero ORDER BY height_cm DESC LIMIT 1

d.request: Who are the tallest superheroes, returning the superhero_name of every superhero whose height_cm equals the maximum height_cm, including all superheroes tied for the top height?
d.sql: SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE height_cm = (SELECT MAX(height_cm) FROM superhero)

b.request: List the superhero_name of every superhero whose height_cm equals the maximum height_cm among all superheroes, including all superheroes tied for the greatest height
b.sql: SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE height_cm = (SELECT MAX(height_cm) FROM superhero)

c.sql: SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE height_cm = (SELECT MAX(height_cm) FROM superhero)
